@s1 stated
  relation "come"
  role subject "the auditor from ISO 27001"
  role location "the server room"
  role time "3 of next month"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s2 stated
  relation "give a non-conformity"
  role subject "the auditor from ISO 27001"
  role object "the server room"
  role topic "the access register was not completed"
  role time "last year"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s3 stated
  relation "take leave"
  role subject "Sorin"
  role time "3 of next month"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@a1 assumed
  relation "be responsible for"
  role subject "Sorin"
  role object "the server room"
  polarity affirmed
  basis implicature

@a2 assumed
  relation "have a key to"
  role subject "Luminita"
  role object "the server room"
  polarity negated
  basis implicature

@a3 assumed
  relation "be new"
  role subject "Luminita"
  polarity affirmed
  basis implicature

@q query
  select ?x
  where match
    relation "be responsible for"
    role subject ?x
    role object "the server room"
    role time "3 of next month"
    polarity affirmed
  end
